description: Project configuration for Phelix. Every field is optional: commands resolve missing values from flags, defaults or interactive prompts.

autoscaling.description: Replica autoscaling. Parsed, validated and resolved, but no component executes scaling decisions yet.

cooldown.description: Wait between scaling decisions as a duration. Defaults to 60s.

scale_down.description: CPU percent that triggers a scale down. Defaults to 30.

scale_up.description: CPU percent that triggers a scale up. Defaults to 70.

evaluation_windows.description: Consecutive samples a condition must hold. Defaults to 1.

interval.description: Evaluation cadence as a duration. Defaults to 15s.

scale_down_p95.description: Proxy p95 latency that triggers a scale down. Defaults to 150ms.

scale_up_p95.description: Proxy p95 latency that triggers a scale up. Defaults to 500ms.

max_replicas.description: Upper replica bound. Defaults to deploy.replicas.

docker.description: Where the image comes from under runtime: docker.

build.description: dockerfile (default) generates or reuses a Dockerfile; compose builds a named compose service.

compose_file.description: Compose file to build from, resolved against the build directory. Defaults to docker-compose.yml.

service.description: Compose service that builds this app's image. Required when build is compose.

network.description: Docker network attached to each app container. Only valid with runtime: docker.

replicas.description: Replica count. Only valid with strategy: rolling.

rolling.description: Worker rolling-replacement parameters. Only valid with type: worker.

drain_timeout.description: Wait after SIGTERM when retiring a replaced replica, as a duration. Falls back to process.shutdown.grace_period.

max_surge.description: Replacements started above the desired count. Only 1 is supported (sequential replacement).

max_unavailable.description: Replicas that may be down during replacement. Only 0 is supported.

canary.description: Canary traffic share as a whole percentage, written as 5 or "5%".

duration.description: Verification window before promotion, as a duration (2m).

steps.description: Progressive steps. Shares must strictly increase and end at 100.

duration.description: How long the share is observed, as a duration.

traffic.description: Canary share for this step as a whole percentage.

verification.description: Regression bounds compared against the stable version.

interval.description: Health and metrics poll cadence as a duration.

max_error_delta.description: Percentage points the canary error rate may exceed the baseline.

max_error_rate.description: Absolute canary error-rate cap, in percent.

max_p95_factor.description: Canary p95 latency ceiling relative to the baseline, at least 1.

runtime.description: native (default) runs host processes; docker runs each instance as a container, which requires a zero-downtime strategy.

strategy.description: classic (default), blue-green, rolling, canary or progressive.

health.description: Health endpoints applied to the app on every build or rebuild.

endpoints.description: Endpoints checked by the health daemon and by deploys.

codes.description: Expected HTTP statuses: a range (200-299) or a list (200,204).

mode.description: Deploy health tier: auto (default), http, tcp-only or none.

name.description: Endpoint name. Must be unique within the file.

path.description: HTTP path on localhost. Must start with /.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout as a duration (5s). Defaults to 10s.

exec.description: Exec probe run per replica when health.mode is exec.

command.description: Probe argv, run without a shell from the app directory. Exit 0 means healthy.

interval.description: Probe cadence as a duration. Defaults to 10s.

retries.description: Consecutive probe failures that mark a replica unhealthy. Defaults to 3.

timeout.description: Per-probe timeout as a duration. Defaults to 5s.

mode.description: Worker health mode: process (default, identity liveness) or exec. Only valid with type: worker.

replace.description: True drops endpoints configured outside this file instead of merging with them.

matrix.description: Build matrix profile: toolchain versions by platform.

enabled.description: Turns the matrix profile on for builds that name no matrix flags.

items.description: Combinations to drop. Keys are dimensions only.

go.description: Go toolchain versions. Mutually exclusive with matrix.rust.

items.description: Toolchain version, quoted or bare ("1.27" or 1.27).
Extra combinations or attributes. Keys are dimensions (go, rust, lang, version, platform, os, arch, variant) or metadata.

rust.description: Rust toolchain versions. Mutually exclusive with matrix.go.

items.description: Toolchain version, quoted or bare ("1.78" or 1.78).

name.description: Application name used by build, rebuild, health and rollback. Optional: build prompts for it when it is missing.

process.description: Worker supervision policy: restarts, backoff, shutdown. Only valid with type: worker.

backoff.description: Restart delay: initial * multiplier^attempt, capped at max, plus jitter.

initial.description: First restart delay as a duration. Defaults to 2s.

max.description: Restart delay cap as a duration. Defaults to 60s.

multiplier.description: Growth factor per consecutive attempt. Defaults to 2.

max_attempts.description: Consecutive failure-driven restarts before the replica enters crashloop. Defaults to 10.

policy.description: always restarts on any exit, on-failure (default) restarts only on a non-zero exit or signal, never leaves a dead replica down.

grace_period.description: Wait between the signal and SIGKILL, as a duration. Defaults to 30s.

signal.description: Signal sent on stop: SIGTERM (default) or SIGINT.

startup_timeout.description: Window a fresh replica has to come up (alive plus health) as a duration. Defaults to 30s.

resources.description: Per-instance CPU and memory limits, enforced through cgroups v2 on Linux only.

cpu.description: CPU ceiling in millicores (500m) or cores (0.5).

secrets.description: Local secret management: maps secrets from the app's encrypted secret store onto environment variables. Values are resolved at launch, never stored in phelix.yaml, and are not part of version snapshots or rollbacks.

imports.description: Declarations of which secrets the application consumes. Manage the secrets themselves with `phelix secrets`.

env.description: Environment variable name the application receives, for example DATABASE_URL. Each name may be declared once; reserved names such as PORT are rejected.

secret.description: Name of the secret in the app's secret store, for example database_url. It must exist in the store when the app starts or deploys.

type.description: Workload type: service (default, a port-listening app) or worker (a supervised background process with no public port).

watching.description: Backend monitoring opt-in: enable or disable. When absent the app keeps its persisted flag.

webhook.description: Git push webhook trigger. Without this block the app never accepts deliveries.

branch.description: Bare branch name whose pushes trigger a rebuild, not a full ref.

enabled.description: Turns the webhook trigger on for this app.

secret_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the HMAC-SHA256 secret. The secret itself is never stored in phelix.yaml.

title: phelix.yaml
